en: Black‑and‑white view of a wide cobbled street in a European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings on both sides. On the left corner is a shopfront with large windows and painted signage. Farther down the street stands an ornate multi‑storey town‑hall‑like building with a tall tower topped by an onion dome and cross. A few pedestrians, including children, are scattered along the nearly empty street.
